title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L722 SafeAAD is sent in cleartext even in a PrivateMessage
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Virtual client actions. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L722.

Text: "The acting emulator client can attach such information to a Commit to
the emulation group using the SafeAAD mechanism described in
{{Section 4.9 of !I-D.ietf-mls-extensions}}."

Problem: SafeAAD is sent in cleartext even in a PrivateMessage. A key_package_upload action therefore shows the emulation group's DS the virtual client's KeyPackageRefs, epoch_id and the uploader's leaf_index. That links published KeyPackages to the emulation group and to a specific emulator client. Privacy Considerations does not mention this.

Suggested fix: List this leak in Privacy Considerations. Alternatively, offer an encrypted carrier, such as an AppEphemeral proposal (extensions-10 §4.8), for deployments where it matters.

Severity: medium. Verifier: narrow (The cleartext claim is confirmed: RFC 9420 PrivateMessage authenticated_data is not encrypted, so a SafeAAD KeyPackageUpload exposes KeyPackageRefs, epoch_id and leaf_index to the emulation group's DS. However, the draft's metadata-hiding goal (L150-159) concerns higher-level group members, and the action is only one MAY option (L732). So 'defeats metadata hiding' is overstated. The defensible core is an undisclosed DS-visible leak.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
